title: Successive urine-flow change does not establish added serum-sodium prediction across NHANES cycles
abstract: In adults with two timed urine voids, adding log second/first urine flow to an additive demographic, renal and collection-timing model did not establish improved serum-sodium prediction from NHANES2011–12 to2013–14: weighted delta MSE 0.082925 (mmol/L)^2, joint source/target bootstrap95% interval [-0.134220,0.589999]. Exploratory, not a clinical hydration test.
